x_note: First-order SMC with sat boundary layer, no integral, designed in the PRSM loop (Documents/SMC/DieuKhien_SMC.txt). lambda, Phi and tau_f chosen by Model/SMC/script/tune_smc.m: phase margin >= 45 deg hard gate, knee of the Pareto front (R, S) on the case TK. Use the values as chosen in load_smc.m.

Ts_ctrl.desc: Sample time of the digital controller (ECU), ZOH at the inputs; same for every controller

lambda.desc: Convergence rate of e_T on the sliding surface (bandwidth of the loop)

tau_f.desc: Time constant of the filtered derivative that estimates theta1_dot

k_sw.desc: Switching gain, larger than the lumped disturbance bound; fixed (only Phi = k_sw/G is tuned); in simulation 100 is enough, 150 chosen

Phi.desc: Boundary layer width = k_sw/G with G = 100 1/s
